alternative.src/invoice.mjs: import {segments} from './segments.mjs';export function invoice(start,end,initial,changes,alreadyCharged){let total=0;const lines=[];for(const s of segments(start,end,initial,changes)){const cents=Number(BigInt(s.price)*BigInt(s.end-s.start)/BigInt(end-start));total+=cents;lines.push({plan:s.plan,start:s.start,end:s.end,cents});}return {lines,total,adjustment:total-alreadyCharged};}
